2 ” to allow audio playback Hello grade 4 learner, today we shall talk about Telling the truth always . Before we start our lesson, what did we learn about Trusting in God? #b ell # Learner, have you remembered about Trusting in God? #b ell # Good. This is what we have learnt: One: When we trust in God, he protects us from evil T w o: Trust in God gives us the strength to say “No” to people and things that can harm us. Three: God promises to protect us and keep us safe if we put our trust in Him Four: When we trust in God we are not afraid Five: Trust in God makes us remain strong whenever we are faced with challenges Six: We trust in God when we tell him everything that affects us through prayer. Seven: God is faithful to us and is patient with us. #m usic # Today we are going to learn about Telling the truth always Why should we tell the truth always? #b ell # Truthfulness is telling the truth no matter what the results are. We are truthful when we tell the truth always. When you lie, you will be caught after sometime and will be punished. It is good to be truthful to God, ourselves and to other people. Learner the Bible teaches us that lies are soon forgotten but the truth will last forever. Did you hear that? The Bible teaches us that lies are soon forgotten but the truth will last forever. Learner, do you have a Bible next to you? I will give you time to open Ephesians 4: 25 and Proverbs 12: 19 #m usic # Learner welcome back. Did you open Ephesians 4: 25 and Proverbs 12: 19? Good lets now read. Ephesians 4: 25 it says no more lying is needed, each of us must tell the truth. No more lying is needed, each of us must tell the truth. Now open Proverbs 12: 19 #m usic #

3 Proverbs chapter 12 verse 19 it says: A lie has a short life but truth lives on forever. A lie has a short life but truth lives on forever. *Music*$(".SCSound") I hope you have already read when we read Ephesians chapter verse 25 and proverbs chapter 12 verse 19. So learner what should you avoid doing? *Bell* Learner did you say that you should avoid lying? Good, what lives a short life? *Bell* I hope you said that a lie lives a short life and that truth lives forever. We should always learn to tell the truth no matter the situation we are in. why do you think it is important to tell the truth? *Bell* It is important to tell the truth because: People trust and respect us when we tell the truth We create true friendship with people when we tell the truth. We get others also to tell the truth when we are truthful. We live happily with each other when we tell the truth always. Telling the truth makes God happy. What have we learnt today? Write in your book. *Music* Today we have learnt that: When we tell lies we get caught after some time. The word of God commands us to stop lying and tell each other the truth because we all belong to Jesus Christ. That lies soon forgotten but the truth lasts forever. We should always tell the truth because the Bible commands us to do. We feel at peace because we are not afraid of guilt for lying. Telling the truth make other people to trust us. Telling the truth helps us to easily make and keep friends. Our friends and teachers can help us tell the truth always Welcome back I hope you enjoyed the lesson. Today we were talking about telling the truth always. Talk about various ways of being truthful to your parents or guardians, remember to share the ways to your siblings at home.
